questions.content: Câu 1: Choose the sentence that is closest in meaning to the original one. The reporter spoke in a confident way, like a professional journalist.
options: A. The reporter spoke as though she were a professional journalist.
B. The reporter spoke as if she was being professional.
C. The reporter spoke so confidently that she became a journalist.
D. The reporter spoke such confidently as a professional journalist.
questions.note: Đáp án đúng: A Giải thích: Mệnh đề trạng ngữ chỉ cách thức “like a professional journalist” → as though / as if she were a professional journalist. Dịch nghĩa: Phóng viên nói chuyện như thể cô ấy là một nhà báo chuyên nghiệp.

questions.content: Câu 2: Choose the sentence that is closest in meaning to the original one. The advertisement was extremely funny. Millions of people shared it online.
options: A. The advertisement was such funny that millions of people shared it online.
B. The advertisement was so funny that millions of people shared it online.
C. The advertisement was as if funny so people shared it.
D. The advertisement was such a funny that it was shared widely.
questions.note: Đáp án đúng: B Giải thích: so + adjective + that + clause → chỉ kết quả. Dịch nghĩa: Quảng cáo hài hước đến mức hàng triệu người chia sẻ nó trực tuyến.

questions.content: Câu 3: Choose the sentence that is closest in meaning to the original one. She behaves like she’s the director of the TV station.
options: A. She behaves as if she were the director of the TV station.
B. She behaves as though she is the director of the TV station.
C. She behaves so confidently that she is the director.
D. She behaves such a director that people believe her.
questions.note: Đáp án đúng: A Giải thích: Mệnh đề trạng ngữ chỉ cách thức “like she’s the director” → as if / as though she were the director. Dịch nghĩa: Cô ấy cư xử như thể là giám đốc của đài truyền hình.

questions.content: Câu 4: Choose the sentence that is closest in meaning to the original one. The documentary was very moving. Everyone talked about it for days.
options: A. The documentary was such a moving that everyone talked about it.
B. The documentary was such moving that people talked about it.
C. The documentary was as though moving so people discussed it.
D. The documentary was so moving that everyone talked about it for days.
questions.note: Đáp án đúng: D Giải thích: so + adj + that + clause → chỉ kết quả. Dịch nghĩa: Bộ phim tài liệu cảm động đến mức mọi người nói về nó suốt nhiều ngày.

questions.content: Câu 5: Choose the sentence that is closest in meaning to the original one. He spoke on the show like he had been a news anchor for years.
options: A. He spoke as if he had been a news anchor for years.
B. He spoke as though he is a news anchor for years.
C. He spoke so fluently that he was a news anchor.
D. He spoke such a news anchor that people believed him.
questions.note: Đáp án đúng: A Giải thích: Mệnh đề trạng ngữ chỉ cách thức “like he had been a news anchor” → as if / as though he had been a news anchor for years. Dịch nghĩa: Anh ấy nói trên chương trình như thể đã là người dẫn bản tin nhiều năm rồi.

questions.content: Câu 6: Choose the sentence that is closest in meaning to the original one. The newsreader speaks clearly and confidently, like an AI-powered assistant.
options: A. The newsreader speaks as if she had been trained by an AI assistant.
B. The newsreader speaks so clearly that she is an AI assistant.
C. The newsreader speaks such clearly as an AI assistant.
D. The newsreader speaks as though she were an AI-powered assistant.
questions.note: Đáp án đúng: D Giải thích: Mệnh đề trạng ngữ “like an AI-powered assistant” → as though / as if she were an AI-powered assistant. Dịch nghĩa: Người đọc bản tin nói chuyện rõ ràng và tự tin như thể là một trợ lý AI.

questions.content: Câu 7: Choose the sentence that is closest in meaning to the original one. The advertisement was very creative. It attracted millions of online views.
options: A. The advertisement was so creative that it attracted millions of online views.
B. The advertisement was as creative as millions of people viewed it.
C. The advertisement was such creative that it went viral.
D. The advertisement was such a creative that it attracted millions.
questions.note: Đáp án đúng: A Giải thích: so + adj + that + clause → chỉ kết quả. Dịch nghĩa: Quảng cáo sáng tạo đến mức thu hút hàng triệu lượt xem trực tuyến.

questions.content: Câu 8: Choose the sentence that is closest in meaning to the original one. He reported the event like he had been at the scene himself.
options: A. He reported the event as though he had been at the scene himself.
B. He reported the event so exactly that he was there.
C. He reported the event such exactly as he had been there.
D. He reported the event as though he has been there.
questions.note: Đáp án đúng: A Giải thích: Mệnh đề trạng ngữ “like he had been…” → as though / as if + past perfect. Dịch nghĩa: Anh ấy tường thuật sự kiện như thể chính mình đã có mặt tại hiện trường.
